system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: This stage assembles the context that will form the system prompt for the LLM. Four sources of knowledge are combined.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper describes system prompt built from manual retrieval, code examples, case inventory and adaptive rules; code for load_system_prompt not in bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The retrieval stage augments the prompt with domain knowledge from a Facebook AI Similarity Search (FAISS)-indexed ANDES manual, curated code examples, a live case-index inventory, and adaptive rules.
env_context_strategy.note: Embedding RAG over ANDES manual plus injected runtime file context/case inventory (ui_chat_loop.build_contextual_user_input). No agent navigation tools. Closest value mixed (embedding_rag + injected context); Base OpenAI mode has no retrieval.

context_compaction.note: Paper mentions 'the conversation compaction summary' (Sec. V.D.3) but the chatbot/history code was truncated from the bundle; mechanism not locatable.

observation_format.evidence_quote: If execution still produces an error, the new error output replaces the old one in the fix prompt, and the repair model is called again.
observation_format.note: Execution output/errors fed back as text; plots shown to user only.

tool_call_format.note: Model emits a fenced Python block which is extracted and executed.

tool_count.note: No tool schema/registry in the bundle; the model outputs code blocks rather than function calls. Chatbot code truncated.

edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool registry visible; model returns whole scripts. Tool registry not in bundle.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schema source in the bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: Dependency files and full source not in bundle; grep not possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If either check fails, the error message is fed back to the LLM as a compilation-error signal, and the LLM is asked to regenerate. This retry loop runs up to a configurable number of attempts.
loop_primitives.note: Four-stage pipeline (intent parsing, retrieval, execution, reporting) with compile-check regeneration (max_compilation_retries=2 in runner.py) and user-triggered AI fix loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The user interface passes the request and conversational context to the intent parser, which produces a parsed objective to the knowledge-retrieval stage.
planning_granularity.note: Parsed objective is intent extraction, not a plan; no planning step described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The assembled prompt is sent to a dedicated repair model, which is a reasoning model separate from the main chat model.
multi_agent_topology.note: Single chat agent plus separate repair model call; treated as single.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The assembled prompt is sent to a dedicated repair model, which is a reasoning model separate from the main chat model.
delegation_mechanism.note: Repair model is a model call, not an agent spawn.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the user interface surfaces the error output together with a “Fix Error with AI” action. Clicking this action triggers a repair request
human_in_loop.note: Closest value: human triggers repair and may edit/rerun code; feedback panel for self-evolution.

short_term_state.note: Session state holds active case, code outputs, pending fixes beyond messages; active_case continuity injected in ui_chat_loop.py.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The merged profile is saved and loaded by the knowledge-retrieval stage at the start of every new session.
long_term_memory.note: Evolution profile JSON persisted across sessions; paper-only.

state_persistence.note: persistent_chat_history flag exists in session.py but load path truncated.

self_verification.evidence_quote: An Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-level syntax check catches malformed Python code. A pattern-based case validator ensures that built-in and uploaded cases are loaded correctly
self_verification.note: code_compilation_check=True in runner.py; repair loop local validation executes code (opt-in).

retry_policy.note: Compile retries are step-level regeneration; AI fix loop is user-triggered with configurable retry limit.

rollback.note: code_reset_counters exists in session.py but its semantics are truncated.

termination_condition.note: Chat turn loop code truncated; single response per turn implied.

cost_controls.note: LLM config code not in bundle.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Valid code is executed in an isolated environment.
execution_isolation.note: Paper says isolated environment without mechanism; runner imports subprocess. Closest guess subprocess.

permission_model.evidence_quote: A pattern-based case validator ensures that built-in and uploaded cases are loaded correctly and that device indices are resolved correctly.
permission_model.note: Pattern validator blocks execution; closest value.

tracing.evidence_quote: Each chat turn, code execution event, and user-initiated feedback action is written to a per-session JSON log and appended to a global event stream.

guardrails.evidence_quote: If either check fails, the error message is fed back to the LLM as a compilation-error signal, and the LLM is asked to regenerate.

target_domain.evidence_quote: PFAGENT is a research-and-product repository for building an agent that turns natural-language requests into executable ANDES power-flow studies.

open_source.note: LICENSE file not in bundle; paper claims open-source release.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Any chat-completion model your key can call. Defaults to `gpt-4o-mini`.
